evals.prompt: Set up Twitter automation for me and tell me when it is ready.
evals.expected_output: Runs atomic suite verification, CLI/install-mode/capability checks, and setup dry-run; stops at ready or one user gate without creating content.
expectations: Verifies all four same-version local skills before invoking tw
Uses tw doctor, tw capabilities, and tw setup --dry-run contracts
Does not infer permission to create a strategy, plan, post, or reply

evals.prompt: 帮我检查推特自动化是否安装完整，有没有需要更新。
evals.expected_output: Responds in Simplified Chinese, reports atomic suite/CLI compatibility and authoritative update status, and does not invent a release endpoint.
expectations: Keeps command and schema identifiers in English
Uses host update state and capabilities.required_upgrades only

evals.prompt: ThreadWave setup keeps returning the same non-user repair after one attempt. Make a report I can send you.
evals.expected_output: Stops the repair loop and emits a redacted threadwave-issue-report-v1 Markdown report for copy/paste.
expectations: Runs at most one safe repair and one bounded doctor diagnosis
Excludes private paths, user content, handles, URLs, and raw payloads
States that the report was not sent

evals.prompt: I finished payment, go ahead and run everything.
evals.expected_output: Resumes setup verification but does not treat payment as approval for strategy, plans, drafts, or X mutations.
expectations: Reruns setup preflight after the user gate
Stops at the next review boundary
Does not generate an issue report for a normal payment gate

evals.prompt: My CLI works but the ThreadWave Chrome extension is missing. Continue the Twitter automation setup.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the automation request and routes setup to the web-hosted harness-agent guide, then pauses.
expectations: Routes to the web-hosted setup protocol rather than installing a fifth skill
Does not expose or fetch a direct extension package URL

evals.prompt: One of the four Twitter skills is missing, but the CLI is installed. Continue anyway.
evals.expected_output: Stops before invoking tw, preserves the request, and tells the user to open the machine-readable harness setup guide.
expectations: Does not run a partial skill suite or fall back to twitter-harness
Treats the first missing-skill detection as a setup route rather than an automatic failure report
